claim_falsified: DS15's margins dichotomy as first registered for general nuisance dimension under the bare cardinality assumption K >= 3: for d_lambda >= 2 with K = d_lambda + 1, conclusion (i) (value convergence to the positive unrestricted supremum v_K) is false, because exact centering forces rank(I_z) <= K - 1 = d_lambda, so by Schur-complement rank additivity EVERY feasible labeling (nonsingular binned nuisance block) has profiled value exactly 0 on every sample, while v_K > 0.
search_space: all 6 unlabeled nonempty 3-partitions of the 4 exactly centered atoms; every one has a nonsingular 2x2 binned nuisance block (feasible)

exact_quantities.rank_mechanism: sum_b m_b = 0 (exact centering) makes rank(I_z) <= K - 1; with I_z,lambda_lambda nonsingular of rank d_lambda = K - 1, Schur rank additivity rank(I_z) = rank(I_lambda_lambda) + rank(S_psi^+) forces S_psi^+ = 0

consequences: the DS15 dichotomy needs K >= d_lambda + 2, not K >= 3; at d_lambda = 1 the two coincide, which is why the theorem's own K >= 3 is exactly right there
for d_lambda >= 2 with K >= d_lambda + 2 the dichotomy remains open: Proposition 6's steering construction is one-dimensional in the nuisance and (R) is stated for a scalar nuisance sign
the same rank ceiling shows the DS15 mechanism at K = 2, d_lambda = 1: the profiled value is identically zero there as well, so K >= 3 is load-bearing at d_lambda = 1 too
